title: OpenAI's Two New Models Are 4x Apart on Price
script: OpenAI just launched two new models with very different prices. A week after Claude 5.2, here come Astra and Sol. Astra is for the hardest projects: documents, slides, code, even 3D design. Sol is the efficient everyday model. Astra: eight dollars in, forty out per million tokens. Sol: two dollars in, ten out. Same family, four times apart on price. OpenAI says Astra more than doubled Claude Fable 5.2's pass rate on a legal test, at about one-sixth the cost.
cta: Follow AI Tested for the next model war move.
